title: [29.X]Non-Deductible Reverse-Charge VAT Correction Is Posted to Purchase VAT Account Instead of Payment Discount Account.
summary: Non-deductible reverse-charge VAT correction is fixed to post to the payment discount account instead of the purchase VAT account across multiple localization layers.
key_points: Gen. Jnl.-Post Line now posts the non-deductible reverse-charge VAT correction to the payment discount account instead of the purchase VAT account
Same change applied to the W1 layer and to the APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU layers
Non-deductible VAT payment discount test updated
